items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: And then people like Dempsey and the -- and some of the --

ctx.x: Yes. Yes. For instance, now, every [Pekin] time after I'd leave my work at night, I'd go to the Peek-in or whatever after hour place it was, but usually I'd be working at those places. But most of the other artists would come in to listen to -- not just me, but whatever artist would be there, you know; even if I was off at night, they'd go to hear the other artists that were working at those places. We had little places that we always frequented.
And then people like Dempsey and the -- and some of the --
All the big -- all the big celebrities.
